Walk-in-Interview for Guest Faculty in the Subject of Computer Science
Walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the Subject of Computer
Science for the academic session 2024-25 will be held on 20.09.2024 (Friday) at Rajiv
Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh, at 12:30 PM.
The eligible candidates are required to report in the Committee Room, Rajiv
Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh, at 11:00 AM on 20.09.2024 for
the verification of applications/documents.

All the applicants who are eligible as per UGC/Panjab University, Chandigarh,
norms are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
including publications with photo copies of certificates and 02 passport photographs) for
verification along with duly filled forms giving the details at the time of interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php).
The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till he/she is teaching at
Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab University Constituent College, Mohan Ke Hithar, Guru Har
Sahai, District Ferozepur.
